caption: ✅ Top 6 Tacos in CDMX 🌮 Mexico City is home to the only taco stand with a Michelin star! Here are our top 6 taco shops in CDMX, in no particular order, but number six is our favorite: 1️⃣ **Taquería El Califa de León**   Michelin-starred Gaonera tacos 🌟 We got lucky—no line at first, but it grew fast as we ordered. Tried one of each, and it was worth it! 2️⃣ **El Califa**   Tacos al Pastor were great, but the Tacos de Costras stole the show. 🤤 3️⃣ **Cinco Hermanos**   Don’t miss the Tacos de Suadero at Mercado Merced. A must-visit! 🌮 4️⃣ **Los Güeros**   We tried Tacos de Suadero, Al Pastor, and Tripa—so good we had to go back another night. 😋 5️⃣ **Tacos Chola** (La Condesa)   Our favorite breakfast tacos! The Tacos de Chorizo con Papa were so good we visited twice. 🍳 6️⃣ **Tacos El Paisa**   Our personal number one! Best Tacos de Suadero and Al Pastor. Pro tip: order all your tacos at once to avoid waiting in line twice! 🔥 #CDMXTacos #TacoTour #MexicoCityEats #FoodieFavorites #TacoHeaven #MichelinStarTacos #CapCut
transcript: Here's our top six taco shops in Mexico City, in no particular order. At No. 1, we visited Taqueria El Califa De Leon, the only taco shop with a Michelin star awarded for their Gounera taco. We got lucky, no lines at first, but it grew fast as we ordered. We tried one of each and it was well worth it. At number two, we hit El Califa, where the tacos al pastor were great, but the tacos de Costra stole the show. No. 3 took us to Cinco Hermanos for tacos de suadero, and from there we were on a mission to try as many as we could. Don't miss a spot in Mercado Merced! At No. 4, Los Gordos, we tried tacos de suadero al pastor and tripa. So good we had to go back another night. At No. 5, Tacos Chola in LA Condesa served up our favorite breakfast tacos. We loved the tacos de chorizo con papa so much we visited twice. Finally at No. 6 and our personal No.. 1, Tacos El Paisa, where we found the best tacos de suadero and al pastor. We had to order twice because everything was so delicious. Pro tip order all your tacos at once to avoid waiting in line twice.
